raw: I joined the wrong class at a dance studio. There were couples practicing a waltz around me, and I had my tap shoes in a drawstring bag. That’s the detail that sticks with me—the bag, with completely the wrong shoes inside. Everyone was moving in pairs, and there I was with my tap shoes. A waltz is so smooth, too, and tap makes me think of all that clattering. I felt embarrassed being in the middle of something I clearly hadn’t come for.
